payload.text: For the release after next, to weigh only (intent-vc, 2026-11-12): the macOS stage has no rehearsal before a cut. A dry run starts no leg (lib/cmd/release:1680-1698), app-sign refuses any commit but the release's, and 0337's release gates --leg covers release.legs hosts alone, so a project's first macOS stage runs at its cut. Intent takes that risk for its next cut, and a failure stops before the tag and is re-cut. No issue now, since an open issue would ride 0.1.23 under directive 13.
